checkAllVectorsImported.description:
When set to true, checks if the number of imported vectors matches the number of vectors in the import files.
This helps verify that all vectors were successfully imported into the database.
Note: An error will be thrown when the imported vector count does not match the expected count, which can be caused by any of the following:
      1. When vectors are added to or removed from the vector store during the import/export process.
      2. When vector IDs in the import files overlap with existing IDs in the vector store.
      3. When vectors are only partially imported due to system errors or any other issues.
